project.name: C-04 UI/使用性テスト計画 v2（取込）
project.purpose: viewport基準のUI/使用性/上下移動/操作効率を事前固定しPlaywrightで登録・実行する
project.rules: 結果確認後に基準を緩めない。承認・完了状態を推測変更しない。
project.focus: 対象到達2 viewport以内・主要操作1 viewport以内・1目的3 viewport以内・再走査0
project.next: v2固定基準でPlaywright E2Eを実行する

items.title: 196-item default item view is bounded
items.body:
Actions
[]

Pass
[
  "visible item rows <= 20",
  "no item body text is expanded by default",
  "mobile item-page document height <= 4 viewport heights",
  "desktop item-page document height <= 3 viewport heights",
  "no horizontal overflow"
]

items.title: Known item direct lookup
items.body:
Actions
[
  "open 項目",
  "search TASK-090",
  "open edit",
  "close edit",
  "clear search",
  "search CHECK-34"
]

Pass
[
  "TASK-090 is the only matching row for exact ID search",
  "CHECK-34 is the only matching row for exact ID search",
  "neither lookup scrolls through predecessor rows",
  "target lookup cumulative vertical travel <= 2 viewport heights",
  "mobile target lookup cumulative vertical travel <= 1688px",
  "desktop target lookup cumulative vertical travel <= 2000px"
]

items.title: Kind/status filtering and paging
items.body:

items.title: Primary controls remain reachable
items.body:
Actions
[
  "work in item list",
  "invoke project save or switch project tab"
]

Pass
[
  "primary project actions and project tabs remain visible/reachable while item rows are scrolled",
  "target-to-primary-action vertical travel <= 1 viewport height",
  "sticky controls do not obscure the active item row or modal trigger"
]

items.title: One-objective vertical travel budget
items.body:
Actions
[]

Pass
[
  "each representative objective flow from target discovery through action completion uses cumulative vertical travel <= 3 viewport heights",
  "mobile objective-flow cumulative vertical travel <= 2532px",
  "desktop objective-flow cumulative vertical travel <= 3000px",
  "same range is not returned through and traversed again for the same objective",
  "down-up-down or up-down-up oscillation for one objective = 0"
]

items.title: Delete and reload storage/UI convergence
items.body:
Actions
[
  "save two test projects",
  "reload",
  "delete selected workload",
  "reload",
  "delete remaining plan",
  "reload"
]

Pass
[
  "after first delete GitHub project count is exactly 1 and visible project count is exactly 1",
  "after final delete GitHub project count is exactly 0 and visible project count is exactly 0",
  "deleted projects do not reappear for 5 seconds after final reload",
  "GitHub GET requests used for current workspace reads use an explicit fresh-read policy"
]
